name: org-access
title: Invite-only organization access
description: People join an organization only by invite: members and pending invites, an optional invite link, Sarj creating an organization with its owner, and what the invited person sees.

export const GROUPS = ["Viewer", "Caller", "Editor", "Org Admin"] as const
export type Group = (typeof GROUPS)[number]

export type Member = {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  group: Group
  owner?: boolean
  /** Null for someone auto-enrolled by domain. */

  added: string
}

export type Invite = {
  id: string
  email: string
  group: Group
  invitedBy: string
  sent: string
}
